$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Add-on task

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Choose an optional extra, personalise it and add it to the request.
useFor: Adding one optional, personalised extra to a request.
notFor: An extra that is a service of its own.

allowed: A row of options with Pagination.
forbidden: An option selected in advance when a paid one exists.

allowed: The price, or a plain statement that it is free.
forbidden: A free label that hides a fee.
A message written for the person and sent without review.
An ayah or hadith without its source.

allowed: TabBar action bar · Actions with one Primary.
forbidden: A disabled Primary that hides validation.

rules: One register per block: the message has no price; the price has no blessing (M2, M6).
Quote and cite any religious text; ﷺ in full (M6).
The preview shows exactly what will be delivered.
The Primary stays enabled; errors appear at the field.

allocation.App level: L3 · a task. Entry from its add-on widget only.
allocation.Realm: Emotional when the extra is for someone else: keep the personal block free of prices.

measure.guardrails: requests edited to remove the extra

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.

notes: In the example the extra is a greeting card: a row of card designs, then To and the message, entered from the Gifting widget.
Not for Celebration Cards after a journey: that is a different service.
example.inTheFlowToday: Screens carry the [price] placeholder and three different layouts of the same step.
